paragraphs: Clear Ballot Group builds voting technology for the officials who run elections. The company started out doing post-election auditing. Its stated position is paper ballots that voters can review and verify.

The product line is grouped into tabulation, accessibility, election management, auditing, training and ballot printing. ClearCount, the central count system, runs with Fujitsu and ibml commercial scanners and can tabulate ballots created by all major voting systems. The newer Nexus hardware can be deployed either as a standalone tabulator or as a hybrid ballot marking device. Nexus does not rely on QR codes, barcodes or OCR to capture or count votes.

The company says its election technology is currently used in thirteen states. It reports partnerships with more than 150 jurisdictions. It also says its systems scale to jurisdictions of all sizes and respond to the budget realities of counties and municipalities.

quote.text: committed to paper ballots that voters can review, verify, and trust
